top_signals.title: Nearly $1M in Pokémon and sports cards vanish from FedEx truck, driver discovers missing lock
top_signals.summary:
A FedEx driver discovered a missing cargo-door lock and nearly $1 million in stolen trading cards outside a California grading facility. Detectives are reviewing his account and seeking surveillance footage to determine how the shipment disappeared.

The post Nearly $1M in Pokémon and sports cards vanish from FedEx truck, driver discovers missing lock appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
